snippet.title: The Phantom Game - Pre Sales Open Now!
snippet.description:
You know can pre-order The Phantom directly from our Shop and get a Digital Art Book, and a Digital SoundTrack from the game.
We also have some amazing exclusive covers created by renowned artists around the world waiting for you.
Check it out in the link below:
https://artofplayshop.com/

Follow us on our social media:
Twitter - https://twitter.com/_phantomgame
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/phantomgameofficial/
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/phantomgameofficial/

And join our Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/pu7NUjp2E3
